source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for row in out:
        colors = set(row)
        if len(colors) == 2:
            repeated = max(colors, key=row.count)
            other = next(c for c in colors if c != repeated)
            if row.count(repeated) == len(row) // 2 and row.count(other) == len(row) // 2:
                # Extend the short stripe by encoding its missing half in color 1.
                for i, value in enumerate(row):
                    if value == repeated:
                        row[i] = 1
                # Preserve the stripe that was present in the input.
                # (the input stripe is the non-background run; in these tasks
                # it occupies one contiguous half of the row.)
                for i, value in enumerate(grid[out.index(row)]):
                    if value == other:
                        row[i] = other
    return out
